evals.name: learn-skill-creator-rationale
evals.prompt: I want to learn the rationale behind the skill-creator skill. I'm a developer who uses Claude Code daily and I'm curious about why the skill system was designed the way it is. I have about 5-8 hours per week to dedicate to this learning project. Help me create a goal record for this.
evals.expected_output: A timestamped goal-record file with four sections (Overall Goal, Current Level Baseline, Learning Habits and Unit Capacity, Staged Task List) and an entry in revise-note.md. The scope should be appropriately sized for 5-8 hours/week of learning.
